title: Make the mathematics visible
outcome: Build a small interactive forecast with adjustable weights for recent form and home advantage.

blocks.body: Question: How do numbers become a model?
Mathematics: Refresh equations, slopes, powers, exponentials, logarithms, function composition, and coordinate plots.

Dataset: StatsBomb Open Data: competitions.json → matches/{competition_id}/{season_id}.json. Use scores, dates, and information available before kickoff. Build recent-form features only from earlier matches.
Reading: ISL chapters 2 and 4. Use logarithms as measurements of multiplicative change.

blocks.title: 3Blue1Brown · visual mathematics
blocks.note: Find the linear algebra and calculus lessons. Recreate one visual idea in code.

blocks.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning · Python
blocks.note: Use selected chapters and Python labs. The book PDF is free on the authors’ site.

blocks.body: Challenge: Explain why a tiny probability for the actual outcome produces a large log loss. Calculate one example.
